description: This file implements utility functions for managing and operating on parameter lists within the SLAP component, including shifting, comparing, initializing, cloning, and cleaning parameter lists.

methods.name: void SlapVhoShiftLeftParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE param_list,ULONG tbs_num)
methods.description: Shifts the elements of a parameter list to the left by a specified number of positions, cleaning and reinitializing shifted-out variables.

methods.name: void SlapVhoShiftRightParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE param_list,ULONG tbs_num)
methods.description: Shifts the elements of a parameter list to the right by a specified number of positions, cleaning and reinitializing vacated variables.

methods.name: BOOL SlapVhoEqualParamLists(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE list1,ANSC_HANDLE list2,BOOL b_syntax_only)
methods.description: Compares two parameter lists for equality, with an option to compare only syntax types.

methods.name: void SlapVhoInitParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE param_list)
methods.description: Initializes a parameter list by setting the count to zero and initializing each variable.

methods.name: void SlapVhoCloneParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE src_param_list,ANSC_HANDLE * dst_param_list)
methods.description: Clones a source parameter list into a destination list, allocating memory if necessary and copying variables.

methods.name: void SlapVhoCleanParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE param_list)
methods.description: Cleans a parameter list by cleaning all variables and resetting the count.
